description: Read the PLACE KEEPER RESERVE. mandateId: one record by its id, with its status, its window, its cap and what is left of it, the acts the keeper may prepare, and no place (a record has no verifier path yet, so its place is shown only to the holder who signed it), never a wallet and never the holder's words. view counts: how many records stand and what they stand for in NET units, with how many are typed as public ground or private (no cell is listed), never a wallet and never an id. With nothing passed, the counts are read. The program is held off until the operator switches it on, and until then the counts say so plainly; a record that exists can be read at any time. This tool moves no NET, and the house pays, holds and sells nothing through it. Free, keyless, nothing to sign. Cost and signer: free and keyless, nothing to sign.

mandateId.description: One record's id (the id it was signed under).
